note: The guide catalogue. Every stated guide count on the site derives from this file, so adding a guide means adding its slug to a group here and running scripts/sync-counts.py. verify.py checks both directions: every page in guides/ must be listed here, and every slug here must have a page. Group keys are the ones the copy names: 'winter' is the winter-season set the homepage shows as a grid, 'fix' is the second homepage grid (fault-finding plus the two numbers guides).
